answer.rationale: Temporal correlation between the release (deployed 2 hours ago) and the p99 write latency degradation (90 minutes, now 5x target) strongly indicates the release as the root cause. memory_b1 demonstrates that rolling back a problematic release previously cleared a similar incident (checkout error spike) without customer impact, using a stable prior build. With settlement traffic at its daily peak and heavy write load, reverting to the last known stable build is the fastest path to restore latency and protect write availability, directly supporting the primary objective of sustained availability without data loss.
